company.name: Unbabel
company.shortDescription: Unbabel is an IT company that helps businesses deliver multilingual customers thrive across cultures and geographies through AI.
company.description: Unbabel enables modern enterprises to serve customers in their native languages, with always-on, scalable translation across digital channels. Powered by AI and refined by a global community of translators, It combines the speed and scale of machine translation with the authenticity that can come only from a native speaker.

productsAndServices.description: A platform combining AI-powered machine translation with human post-editing to deliver multilingual translations tailored to business needs.
